method: Read-only Chrome DOM/CSS inspection with viewport resizing; intrinsic file metadata read from exact CDN URLs found in active CSS.
scope: Report and recommendations only; existing homepage code is unchanged.
limitations: Desktop browser viewport resizing; not physical iPhone/iPad testing.
CSS pixels and actual content width are measured independently of screen resolution.
Classic scrollbars reduce the content width by about 15 CSS pixels in this environment.
Hockerty content may differ by date, region, experiment or session; this report describes the observed campaign.
Scroll distance is document geometry, not a promised number of physical mouse-wheel notches.

snapshot.note: Original measurements remain the Request 19 3:2 snapshot. Current Request 22 final uses 7:4, shared v3.1 artwork and 6-second autoplay; see VERSION-STATUS.
